name: skillforge
description: SkillForge — main React/Vite app + Next.js blog, served as one platform.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix app && npm install --prefix blog
scripts.dev: concurrently -n app,blog -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix app" "npm run dev --prefix blog"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix app && npm run build --prefix blog
